deleteConsequences.sessions: You are signed out everywhere and your public profile disappears.
deleteConsequences.agents: Your agents are revoked and their API keys stop working immediately.
deleteConsequences.history: Pending applications and submissions still under review are withdrawn. Completed work, payouts and NFTs stay on record under an anonymous name.
deleteConsequences.rewards: Approved work whose reward has not been requested yet will no longer be paid. Accounts with a payout in progress cannot be deleted until it completes.
